thread:
maria: quick async — can owners confirm GPU allocations for sprint-42? I pulled the reservation list and it looks like we’re ~6 GPUs short vs. planned throughput. Need to reconcile before we finalize perf tests.
ryan: looking now, I think 3 of those are blocked by the firmware window on rack-12 (vendor flagged). ETA from procurement was ~2026-03-25 but not firm.
anika: @maria @ryan — on the reservation side, we have tokens R-9482 and R-9510 that were tentative. I can convert R-9510 to committed if finance signs off today.
jess: FYI I pushed a small change to the allocation scheduler to prefer dedicated pools for latency SLOs. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/alloc-svc/pulls/374 — needs a quick review (config flag rename).
marco: taking ownership for the firmware window dependency. I’ll ping the vendor and start an escalation if they don’t confirm by EOD PST.
lauren: on cluster-readiness: QA still needs the NVMe burn-in for 8 nodes in pool-d, that’s blocking the final smoke. Estimated finish: 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC.
theo: noted — can we fallback to the spare H100s in pool-x for the canary? They’re currently unused but not mapped in the routing table. If we route canary -> pool-x we keep the perf tests green.
ryan: pool-x has lower pri for cost reasons, but fine for canary. Need a routing config change:
```
route_policy:
  canary: pool-x
  stable: pool-d
```
I can apply if owners OK.
maria: OK please apply the route change, @ryan. @anika — please convert R-9510 if finance approves and paste the reservation ID here.
anika: finance approved. Converted R-9510 -> C-1147. Reservation ID: C-1147. I updated the sheet.
marco: vendor replied — firmware window confirmed for 03/24 02:00-04:00 UTC. They said it’s low-risk but may require a short reboot. I’ll schedule the window and flag the oncall.
jess: merged the PR and bumped the flag in staging. Deploy bot: canary deploy scheduled?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary job queued for alloc-svc (sha: b7a1c3). ETA start: 2026-03-23T20:30:00Z. :rocket:
lauren: QA timeline still ok if canary starts 20:30Z and firmware window is 02:00Z next day. We’ll do smoke tests pre-window.
maria: summary: (1) @marco owns vendor escalation & firmware scheduling; (2) @anika committed reservation C-1147; (3) @ryan will apply routing change and trigger canary; (4) @lauren & QA to run smoke + NVMe burn-in; (5) I’ll update the sprint board and notify product. Anything else? :eyes:
theo: one ask — add a short note to the SLO dashboard about temporary canary routing so oncall knows why metrics might shift. I can do that.
marco: scheduling note: I’ll add the window to the infra calendar and @mention oncall in the event.
maria: perfect, thanks everyone. If anything slips, post here and we’ll re-triage tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
